rumors.content: Word is that Webb failed 30% of the class last semester. No curve. Zero mercy. A senior told me he literally said 'a C is a gift' when asked about grade distribution.

Priya has already predicted the midterm will have a trick DP problem disguised as a recursion question. She's been right about the last two exams.
There's a leaked 'study guide' circulating on Discord that supposedly came from last year's TA. Kevin has NOT confirmed or denied this. Suspicious.
